summary: Atlantic American Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing a Fourth Amendment (October 9, 2026) and Fifth Amendment and Waiver (October 15, 2026) to its May 12, 2021 Revolving Credit Agreement with Truist Bank. The amendments extend delivery deadlines for audited FY2025 consolidated financial statements—now no later than October 23, 2026—and for interim 2026 quarterly statements through November 30, 2026, plus related covenant compliance certificates. The Fifth Amendment lowers the required AM Best financial strength rating for subsidiary American Southern Insurance to no lower than A- and waives prior related defaults. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch for delayed audited financials and covenant pressure.
